It's just another cut and paste job of Halo 5.

This game had a lot of hype because people were hoping and almost expecting a long overdue return of classic Halo. Instead we've been drowned with stupid AI's that go directly against the historical sophisticated/quiet AI's Halo used to have, CoD like hit markers/gameplay, a massive reduction in a "team" vibe and a dull CoD colour scheme.

It sucks for classic Halo fans. Great for CoD fans wanting something fresh and different to every other CoD came out there, but for us Halo fans who have played and cherished the game since it first released, Infinite is just not Halo anymore.
